rubric: Frame and assumptions stated; the safety screen applied (doctor's go-ahead for chest pain, operations, pregnancy, uncontrolled conditions) before a plan.
Four weeks laid out by day with exact sets x reps or minutes and an effort cue; rest days; week 1 easy, about 10 % more each week, week 4 like week 3.
Weight goals use a moderate deficit, 0.25 to 0.5 kg a week, and say what to measure; no crash diet, no result promised by a date.
Sleep advice as a routine with clock times (fixed wake time, caffeine cut-off, screens off, room temperature, the 20-minute rule) and the signs needing a doctor.
Stop signs and the one habit to start this week; a beginner never gets 6 days a week.
